name: POST /api/speech/credentials/:binding_id/validate - Validate a tenant key and probe its capacity
description: Validates one of the caller's tenant keys (an ai-gateway tenant credential binding of any voice layer) by making one cheap read-only call to its provider, and stores the outcome on the binding (7227c780-62bf-4956-b678-56562cd0ed74#AC1 — validating a key returns ok or a typed failure and, when available, the rate-limit tier and max safe concurrency). validation.status is ok | invalid_key (401, or Gemini 400 API_KEY_INVALID) | insufficient_permissions (403) | rate_limited (429; the key is valid) | provider_error (5xx, timeout, unreachable) | unsupported (no probe, e.g. Bedrock). A rejected key is a RESULT, so the response is 200 with the typed status and a redacted error message — never the key, the probe URL or last_4. rate_limit_tier and max_concurrency are set only when the provider reports them: requests-per-minute headers (x-ratelimit-limit-requests / anthropic-ratelimit-requests-limit) convert to concurrent calls at SPEECH_LLM_REQUESTS_PER_CALL_MIN (default 20) per call; ElevenLabs reports its subscription tier and Twilio its account type. The stored max_concurrency is the dialer's key cap for agents whose telephony credential is this binding. A binding of another tenant or an unknown id is 404; a revoked binding is 409.

errorCases.when: no binding with that id for the caller's tenant (includes another tenant's binding)
